# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the **latest release** of Cull receives security updates. Please make sure
you are running the most recent version from the
[Releases](https://github.com/manishprivet/cull/releases) page before reporting
an issue.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues,
discussions, or pull requests.

Instead, report them privately using GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/manishprivet/cull/security/advisories/new).
This keeps the details confidential until a fix is available.

When reporting, please include as much of the following as you can:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- The version of Cull and the operating system affected
- Any suggested mitigation, if you have one

## What to Expect

- We will acknowledge your report as soon as we are able.
- We will investigate and keep you informed of our progress.
- Once a fix is released, we are happy to credit you for the discovery if you wish.

Thank you for helping keep Cull and its users safe. 🙏
